snippet.title: Office Aberrations - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Office Aberrations is a first-person, spot-the-difference game, where you are stuck in an endlessly looping hallway.  Determine if anything is out of place by carefully examining your surroundings.  No detail is too small.  Knowing if and where there are aberrations is your only way out.

► Wishlist "Office Aberrations": https://store.steampowered.com/app/3157670utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=npg_channel_trailer_1&utm_medium=free
